quests.hint: To reschedule a dentist appointment to a later date because of a scheduling conflict.
quests.explanation: POST- means 'after'. POST- + PONE = POSTPONE, meaning to delay something until a later time.

quests.hint: Describing the economic recovery a country experiences in the years following a conflict.
quests.explanation: POST- means 'after'. POST- + WAR = POSTWAR, meaning occurring after a war.

quests.hint: The playoff games a team competes in after the regular schedule ends.
quests.explanation: POST- means 'after'. POST- + SEASON = POSTSEASON, meaning occurring after the regular season.

quests.hint: To move forward with the meeting once the last guest finally arrives.
quests.explanation: PRO- means 'forward'. PRO- + CEED = PROCEED, meaning to move forward or continue.

quests.hint: To move a hardworking employee up to a senior management position.
quests.explanation: PRO- means 'forward'. PRO- + MOTE = PROMOTE, meaning to raise someone to a higher position.

quests.hint: To gather with signs outside city hall, speaking out against a new policy.
quests.explanation: PRO- can mean 'in favor of' or, combined here, 'forth'. PRO- + TEST = PROTEST, meaning to publicly object to something.

quests.hint: The printer jamming right before an important deadline, refusing to work properly.
quests.explanation: MAL- means 'badly' or 'poorly'. MAL- + FUNCTION = MALFUNCTION, meaning to fail to work correctly.

quests.hint: A serious health crisis caused by a diet lacking essential vitamins and minerals.
quests.explanation: MAL- means 'badly' or 'insufficiently'. MAL- + NUTRITION = MALNUTRITION, meaning poor or insufficient nutrition.

quests.hint: To handle a fragile package roughly, ignoring the 'handle with care' label.
quests.explanation: MAL- means 'badly'. MAL- + TREAT = MALTREAT, meaning to treat someone or something badly.

quests.hint: Describing a violinist's performance so skillful it left the entire hall speechless.
quests.explanation: EXTRA- means 'beyond'. EXTRA- + ORDINARY = EXTRAORDINARY, meaning beyond what is ordinary.

quests.hint: The debate club and chess team a student joins outside of regular class hours.
quests.explanation: EXTRA- means 'outside of'. EXTRA- + CURRICULAR = EXTRACURRICULAR, meaning outside the regular curriculum.

quests.hint: Describing a creature from a science fiction film that supposedly came from another planet.
quests.explanation: EXTRA- means 'beyond' or 'outside'. EXTRA- + TERRESTRIAL = EXTRATERRESTRIAL, meaning beyond or outside the Earth.

quests.hint: Describing skin that reacts painfully to even the gentlest soap.
quests.explanation: HYPER- means 'excessive' or 'over'. HYPER- + SENSITIVE = HYPERSENSITIVE, meaning excessively sensitive.

quests.hint: A chronic medical condition in which a patient's blood pressure stays dangerously high.
quests.explanation: HYPER- means 'excessive'. HYPER- + TENSION = HYPERTENSION, meaning excessively high blood pressure.

quests.hint: The blue underlined text on a webpage that takes you to another page when clicked.
quests.explanation: HYPER- here means 'beyond the ordinary'. HYPER- + LINK = HYPERLINK, a connection that jumps beyond a single page.

quests.hint: The years a student spends in school and university, gaining knowledge and skills.
quests.explanation: -TION turns a verb into a noun naming a process. EDUCATE + -TION = EDUCATION (the final 'e' is dropped), the process of educating.

quests.hint: The final choice a jury makes after hours of deliberating a verdict.
quests.explanation: -SION turns a verb into a noun. DECIDE + -SION = DECISION (the spelling changes to 'cis'), the act of deciding.

quests.hint: A company's plan to open twenty new stores across the country next year.
quests.explanation: -SION turns a verb into a noun naming a process. EXPAND + -SION = EXPANSION (the spelling changes to 's'), the process of expanding.

quests.hint: Describing a steep mountain trail that is icy, narrow, and prone to rockslides.
quests.explanation: -OUS means 'full of'. DANGER + -OUS = DANGEROUS, meaning full of danger.

quests.hint: Describing an actor whose face is instantly recognized by millions around the world.
quests.explanation: -OUS means 'full of'. FAME + -OUS = FAMOUS (the final 'e' is dropped), meaning full of fame.

quests.hint: Describing the shaky hands of a student waiting to walk on stage for a speech.
quests.explanation: -OUS means 'full of'. NERVE + -OUS = NERVOUS (the final 'e' is dropped), meaning full of nervous energy.

quests.hint: Describing a designer who dreams up bold, original ideas no one has tried before.
quests.explanation: -IVE means 'having a tendency toward'. CREATE + -IVE = CREATIVE (the final 'e' is dropped), meaning having a tendency to create.

quests.hint: Describing a storefront window display so eye-catching it draws customers off the street.
quests.explanation: -IVE means 'having a tendency toward'. ATTRACT + -IVE = ATTRACTIVE, meaning having the power to attract.

quests.hint: Describing a manager who checks in daily and offers real help during a stressful project.
quests.explanation: -IVE means 'having a tendency toward'. SUPPORT + -IVE = SUPPORTIVE, meaning having a tendency to support others.

quests.hint: The thick reference book you check when you're unsure how to spell a word.
quests.explanation: -ARY means 'relating to' or 'a place associated with'. DICTION + -ARY = DICTIONARY, a place of collected words.

quests.hint: Describing a chess match so remarkable that players still study it decades later.
quests.explanation: -ARY means 'relating to'. LEGEND + -ARY = LEGENDARY, meaning relating to a legend.

quests.hint: Describing the strict limits a department must follow to avoid overspending its funds.
quests.explanation: -ARY means 'relating to'. BUDGET + -ARY = BUDGETARY, meaning relating to a budget.

quests.hint: To condense a three-hundred-page report into a single readable paragraph.
quests.explanation: -IZE means 'to make or become'. SUMMARY + -IZE = SUMMARIZE (the 'y' changes to 'i'), meaning to make a summary of something.
quests.meaningBreakdown: SUMMARI (root, y changes to i) + IZE (suffix, 'make')

quests.hint: To point out every flaw in a colleague's proposal during the team meeting.
quests.explanation: -IZE means 'to make or become'. CRITIC + -IZE = CRITICIZE, meaning to make critical judgments about something.

quests.hint: For a general doctor to focus their training entirely on treating heart conditions.
quests.explanation: -IZE means 'to make or become'. SPECIAL + -IZE = SPECIALIZE, meaning to become a specialist in something.
